name: Fatim Zahrae Tijani
short_description: I build modern, responsive, and functional web applications using JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, and MySQL.
about: I’m Fatim Zahrae Tijani, a Master 2 student in Application Design & Development (ICDA) with a strong interest in web development. I enjoy building practical web applications and exploring both frontend and backend development. Through my academic and personal projects, I have worked with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, PHP, and Laravel. I am currently focusing on strengthening my skills in JavaScript full-stack development, particularly with React, Node.js, Express.js, and SQL. I’m looking for an opportunity where I can contribute to real-world projects, continue learning, and grow as a developer.
